scope: Native macOS public normalized rebuild, full check, cited retrieval, and managed source refresh at 1,000 and 10,000 current 100,000-byte sources, with 133 authored/graph records and a held predecessor snapshot. This does not establish 100,000-document capacity or unseen answer completeness.

limits.production_check_limits: Use existing defaults unchanged:30min,32GiB scratch main pages,32MiB perconnection caches and existing row/history/VM/posting/IO ceilings. No override to manufacture pass. Rebuild30min watchdog is this finite control-run stop; documented full-tier rebuild4h remains unchanged. Refresh observed UX retained; this control does not replace frozen60s full-tier change gate.

tiny_rehearsal.source_selection: First two sources from the verified 1,000-source export, preserving IDs and the matching 133-file overlay. Rehearsal only; full tiers use entire exports.

measurement.pair: Monotonic interval from check launch through cited-query completion. Full inventories, fixture hashing, and executable pin checks occur outside that interval. Monitoring and bounded output processing remain included.
measurement.scratch: Report observed physical allocation separately from returned logical SQLite scratch bytes. Sampled peaks are lower bounds. Tiny must observe a reference.sqlite path inside its owned command TMPDIR.
measurement.holder: Real QuerySnapshot retained across rebuild, checks, and refresh. The test-only final three document reads rearm a cumulative 30-second/10-million-VM-step budget on the same connection and transaction; production query limits remain unchanged.
measurement.native_memory: Retain native CLI and holder peak RSS; enforce the conservative sum as well as sampled concurrent process memory.

admission.prerequisite: Completed previous tier with identical executable, supervisor, validator, and protocol pins.
admission.ten_k_projection: Multiply the larger 1k pair time, peak check memory, and scratch measure by 20 (10x corpus and 2x uncertainty). Refuse if any projected limit is exceeded.
admission.disk_forecast: Current account allocation + 3x complete selected export allocation + 32 GiB scratch reservation + 2 GiB headroom; also preserve the free-space floor after forecast growth.

required_outcomes: Two public normalized rebuilds; second publication has a newer epoch and a distinct file while the held predecessor remains present.
Complete zero-diagnostic full checks before and after a real second-source refresh, followed by exact-snapshot cited context and authored-ID search.
Exact citation spans/hashes and retained old payload bytes; canonical/control/catalog files unchanged by read-only operations, excluding SQLite SHM read marks and writer-lock diagnostics.
Holder verifies its original rows and snapshot before release; successful command scratch directories are empty.
Final original-seed, overlay, executable, supervisor, validator, and protocol bindings match. Preserve all failed attempts.
interpretation: No statistical p95 claim from two check pairs.
The first post-refresh query is separated from refresh by untimed harness verification; its command duration is not acknowledgment-to-answer latency.
Whole-run time includes fixture/account verification and must be reported separately from CLI timings.
No qualification of broad history churn, import throughput, semantic/hybrid modes, Windows, or unseen answer completeness.

build_profile.evidence: Pin CLI and holder binaries together with source pins and the corresponding compiler actions. Unoptimized earlier runs remain diagnostic evidence and cannot satisfy this release prerequisite chain.
